headline: COLREG Rule 15: Crossing Situation
subheadline: She is on your starboard side?
insight: Then you are the give-way vessel. Take early and substantial action, and avoid crossing ahead of her if the circumstances of the case admit.

meta.description: COLREG Rule 15: when two power-driven vessels are crossing with risk of collision, the vessel which has the other on her own starboard side keeps out of the way.
meta.question: At what range would you alter course here?
meta.altText: Navigation graphic explaining COLREG Rule 15 crossing situation: the vessel with the other on her starboard side gives way.
